author: Postal1996
quote:
Great open world , Graphics and driving but very weak story , bad characters that you don't get attached to and not memorable , dialogue is bad and some parts are bloated and very long especially chapter 4.
The protagonists and Antagonists are bad.
This game is not rdr2 or gta 4 , Expected a good story with strong protagonists like Niko bellic or Arthur or john but No.
Disappointed and this game is nowhere near 99.
